decision.rationale: All thirteen attacks the prompt names are refuted, and five further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v3 — was verified by opening both Stage A files rather than trusting the table: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX on subject 1a04325f…, the frozen v3. All seven citations recompute with zero mismatches. The non-unwrite span was parsed and contains exactly D-167 through D-194, twenty-eight entries, with D-168 present and no gaps, correctly extended by one over D-194's. Every live-state assertion — required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, Condition 2 at 4 of 32, Condition 4 MET, Condition 5 last, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G20 token OPEN, last heading D-194, frozen v2 at HEAD 5d5d778 and required-now 26 — was checked against the live file and holds exactly. The lineage claim over D-170 through D-194 was verified across all twenty-five decisions, as was the 'after D-194' increment. Because this is the seventh draft on the same template, it was specifically tested for copy-forward contamination and contains zero references to any of the six preceding cycles' rows or obligations, with the invention disclaimers specialised to this cycle. Its rationale was checked clause by clause against v3's purpose field, matching even the term 'remainder' that v3 itself uses. The sharpest angle, that a recording act might silently record or upgrade the G20 harness specification whose leftoverNameNote says no leftover-join exists, fails for the same reasons it failed at D-192, D-193 and D-194: the entry records only v3, attributes the authoring claim to the measurement, states 'Not QUALIFIED' twice, leaves file 08 unedited, and the harness is confirmed unrecorded. Three further candidates were examined and recorded as observations because each is true as written. At zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields CONSENT.
